question: What bodily correlate is assigned to the phaṭ-sound in this mapping?
premises: The phaṭ-sound is described as made of the kūrca life-force.
The pair of breasts is named as its correlate.
inference: The phaṭ-sound, imbued with kūrca life-force, corresponds to the pair of breasts.
plain_english: O goddess, the phaṭ-sound, made of the kūrca life-force, is the pair of breasts.
